mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oval is the perspective drawing of the top circular rim. Right image: The oval is the plotted ellipse with horizontal semiaxis 5 and vertical semiaxis 3.
Rationales: The feature shows a circular rim of a solid in perspective in the left image and traces a plane ellipse on the axes in the right image. The continuous oval at the top of the squat cylinder. The closed curve through A1, A2, B1 and B2.
